hardware: XIAO ESP32-C6 and same T94/SSD1680 panel configuration
content: 13920 frames, 60fps, 232 seconds; confirm2 filter except unfiltered baseline
method: For16second movie comparisons, restart the complete movie; summaries omit the first2second startup report and use the following six reports. Probes and short loop controls have no rate-comparison summary. Complete-loop validation is recorded separately.
limits: Active rates exclude full refresh; content_hz counts accepted indices, not optical settling. No optical sensor or camera measurement. Different scan rates change when the2000scan clean occurs.

filtered_only.user_quote: 感觉减轻了，但感觉又差别不明显
filtered_only.interpretation: Possible slight improvement; no clear preference established.

pipeline_on.interpretation: User observed an improvement with the pipeline enabled.

history100.interpretation: Rejected by visual comparison; faster target indexing does not establish quality.

history150.interpretation: No advantage established against the fixed budget.

history200.interpretation: Fixed budgets preferred; return history mode to off.

paired11.interpretation: Reject the appended HOLD phase at FR7 and11/11.

paired15.user_quote: 还是很差的感觉，全屏的残影
paired15.interpretation: Reject this profile as well and restore FR5,11/11,pipelineon,historyoff,pairedoff.

weak_probe11.interpretation: Direction and relative strength unresolved from this first image.

sameA4.user_quote: 不过说实话感觉看不出名堂
sameA4.interpretation: Some mottling difference described; exact optical equality was not established. Cross-row appearance is not used to infer source direction.

weak4.interpretation: On the upper initially-white row, the VSH2-selected patch was visibly lighter than A after four scans. This is qualitative evidence, not a measured strength ratio.

weak_tail1.interpretation: Reject the lightest weak-tail movie profile and restore weak off. Stronger weak-tail settings were not tested after this rejection.
